request.description: BLOODRIDGE CHAMPION: one terrifying Egyptian Medjay grave-duelist, same race and detailed native pixel style as reference, NEW individual and pose. Lean sinewy adult, heroic proportions, small head and long athletic limbs, light battle gear. Low-top-down three-quarter game view facing SOUTHWEST, viewer-left. Coiled contrapposto: chest leans forward above deeply bent leading knee, rear leg braced to right, torso twisted, chin low. TWO clearly gripped substantial bronze KHOPESH, similar length. Lead forearm crosses upper chest; hooked crescent blade projects up-left OUTSIDE face. Rear elbow lifts sideways/back, second blade sweeps down-right OUTSIDE shoulder. Clear negative space between head, swords and arms; two closed hands on short handles, correct wrists, exactly two weapons. SIGNATURE: long asymmetric torn funerary mantle swept behind one shoulder, split pointed linen ends, crescent collar, narrow bare ash-skin chest with sparse ember scars. Low weathered hood/headwrap; visible menacing lava-scarred face and eyes. Wrapped forearms/shins, corroded bronze armbands, short burial sash, exposed toned arms. Rotted sepia/ash rags, stained pale linen and DULL bronze. Orange only in eyes, sparse cracks and sword cutting edges. Dense deliberate tiny pixels and sculpted clusters like reference, strong upper-left light, deep selective outline, varied material values. Body HEAD-TO-FEET 110-112px on 160x168 transparent canvas: head near y28, separate grounded feet at y140. Weapon tips/mantle inside margins. NOT bulky, chibi, clean gold armour, generic bandit, skeleton, beard, mask, chief, antlers, crown, horns, shield or staff. No extra limb/weapon, scene, particles, text, ground, shadow or rescaling. Native game sprite.
request.palette_name: Approved Bloodridge rotted sepia ash linen bronze with ember accents
